Welcome to the Daily Bone Weekend Update where we recap the top stories from the  week. Be sure to check out our daily newsletter to get all of your news hot off the press each and every weekday!

### Headlines

* Tokenized AMC [depegged 50x](https://x.com/adamagb/status/2094156852212761022?s=20) due to memecoin pairings on Robinhood chain — AMC CEO Adam Aron called Robinhood tokenized stocks [“contemptible” and “vile”](https://x.com/Cointelegraph/status/2095785626897400180) while hiring securities lawyers — Related [MEME ](https://dexscreener.com/robinhood/0xc6e298e137f2905398db87e6eae49ede64d231fee37330fa433fec917f4618b6)token surged to  $100M with Frankdegods and Rasmr [up 7 figures](https://x.com/0xkekov/status/2095800118666469495?s=20) on the trade

* House[ canceled final two weeks ](https://x.com/coinbureau/status/2095762558032679379)of September causing doubt that the CLARITY Act will pass before midterms

* Hyperliquid Labs is in advanced talks to bring [perps to U.S.](https://x.com/TheBlockCo/status/2094475125487989167) traders via Kraken parent Payward

* Massive [phishing scam wave](https://x.com/WuBlockchain/status/2094829461317509254?s=20) hit X users

———————————————————————————

### TradFi

* A [strong jobs print](https://x.com/DeItaone/status/2095853065110745311?s=20) caused September interest rate hike[ odds to spike](https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2095854707608572100?s=20)

🧠 Crypto News Brief: Crypto pulled back across the board as a blowout U.S. jobs report revived September rate-hike fears, cooling August's rally. Yet institutional demand held firm — spot Bitcoin ETF assets hit a record $103 billion. 📉 Bitcoin Slides as Blowout Jobs Report Revives Rate-Hike Fears A stronger-than-expected 162,000 U.S. jobs added in August reignited bets on a September Federal Reserve rate hike, pressuring bitcoin and risk assets. BTC slipped from the $81,000 it had reclaimed midweek back toward the high-$70,000s, while ether, XRP and solana all traded lower into the weekend. Combined net assets have now topped a record ~$103 billion, a sign institutional demand held firm even as prices cooled. More details → ⚖️ U.S. Sheriffs' Group Drops Opposition to Clarity Act, Goes Neutral A national sheriffs' association moved its position on the Clarity Act crypto market-structure bill from opposition to neutral, months after warning the law could shield crypto-related crime. The shift removes one obstacle ahead of a pivotal Senate vote expected in mid-September. The approval adds to a growing roster of federally recognized crypto-native institutions and signals continued regulatory openness to on-chain banking. 78592.subject: Important: We will soon be deleting your inactive BKK account
78592.body:
![BudapestGO] (https://hirlevel.bkk.hu/link.php?M=78854635&N=314&L=25&F=T)

Dear Oleg Novosadov,
You have not used your BKK account for a long time, so we will delete your
account and the associated data next month in accordance with the
[BudapestGO privacy notice]
(https://hirlevel.bkk.hu/link.php?M=78854635&N=314&L=157&F=T) .

Important: if you previously uninstalled the app, your account has not been
deleted
You may have previously uninstalled the BudapestGO app from your phone, but
your BKK account has not yet been deleted. This is why you have received
this notification.

If you’d like to keep your account
All you need to do is start using your account again:
1.

Download the BudapestGO app if you don’t currently have it on your phone.

•

[App Store] (https://hirlevel.bkk.hu/link.php?M=78854635&N=314&L=158&F=T)
•

[Google Play] (https://hirlevel.bkk.hu/link.php?M=78854635&N=314&L=159&F=T)

2.

Launch the app.
3.

Log in with your existing BKK account.
If you log in, we will not delete your account.

If you do not wish to keep your account
You do not need to do anything. We will automatically delete your account
and any associated data next month.
If you wish to request immediate deletion of your data, you can do so in
the BudapestGO app via the Menu → My Account → Delete Account option.

What can you expect after deleting your account?
Once your account has been deleted, the following features and settings
will not be available until you register again:
•

purchasing tickets and passes,
•

favourite lines and stops,
•

notifications related to your favourites,
•

newsletter settings,
•

passenger security chat,
•

saved locations in the Trip Planning menu,
•

push notifications.

Once your account has been deleted, any fare products you have purchased
that are linked to your account will also be lost and cannot be recovered
later.

If you would like to keep your account and the associated services, please
log in to the BudapestGO app as soon as possible.

Kind regards:
BKK
We have sent you this notice on the legal basis of the performance of a
contractual obligation, in accordance with Article 6(1)(b) of the GDPR.
This information does not constitute commercial or direct marketing
content.
BKK Centre for Budapest Transport
Phone: +36 1 3 255 255 • e-mail: bkk@bkk.hu
